Title: Demo dry run on prod with seeding scenario
Description: As a product owner, I want a full seeding demo dry run on prod so that we can validate the end-to-end user experience before demo day. The dry run uploads a representative research paper, processes it through the full pipeline, and verifies the output includes the opportunity map, IDF, claim seeds, invention lattice, and scored verdict card, while recording the demo flow and timing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Demo paper is uploaded to prod
Pipeline completes within acceptable time (no timeouts)
Opportunity map is generated and shown on dashboard
IDF with abstract, background, and summary is created
Claim seeds are generated and visible
Invention lattice (core → continuation → platform → system) is constructed
Scored verdict card shows 5 axes with citations
Drill-down shows evidence sources and provenance
Export to PDF and JSON works
Demo flow is recorded; timing and UI/UX are validated
TalkingPoints: I'm going to run the full seeding demo scenario on prod to validate the user experience. I'll upload the demo paper, watch it flow through the pipeline, and verify all outputs are correct. I'm going to record timing and any issues for refinement.
